subject: FluxGrid: Request for safety-net extension and step-up plan
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna@fluxgrid.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial environment exhausted — request for short extension

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note — we hit the usage cap on our FluxGrid POC this morning and the trial credits appear to have fully expired. We were in the middle of a latency/throughput run and only have ~20% of the benchmark completed. Can you help with a short safety-net extension so we can finish the tests? I attached the last run logs and a short timeline of remaining tests.

Procurement is on standby but they want a clear window and agreement before touching purchase paperwork: procurement@fluxgrid.ai. We're asking for 7 days or a one-time top-up equivalent to $2k of usage.

Appreciate any quick help — demo next Tuesday is make-or-break.

Thanks,
Anna Kim
Head of ML, FluxGrid

Attachments: fluxgrid_trial_logs_20260910.csv
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kim <anna@fluxgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial environment exhausted — request for short extension

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for sending logs.

We're happy to help get you across the finish line. I'll loop in our CS and accounts team to confirm an approval path. Two quick asks for me so we can move fast:

- Can you confirm the HubSpot deal id or billing email (so we can attach the addendum)?
- Is a 7-day window enough, or do you prefer a one-time credit top-up? We can do either as a one-off exception.

Tentatively I can commit to escalating for a 7-day safety-net while we sign a short addendum. Ben/Jordan — can one of you confirm authority to grant a $2k one-time credit or a 7-day re-enable for POC accounts?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--

Steph/Jordan — internal note only.

We can approve a one-time $2,000 credit for FluxGrid and re-enable the sandbox for 7 days. Given the deal stage (POC into Mobilize), I recommend we:

- Apply $2k of trial credit immediately, tagged as 'safety-net - one off'
- Send a short addendum (legal template) for signature that states the extension window and scope of usage
- Offer a follow-up health call + a tailored batching/quantization checklist to make sure their final bench finishes within the new window.

I don't see any compliance blockers; procurement should be fine with an addendum. Jordan, can you apply the credit later today and attach the addendum link to the response?

-Ben

What's included:
- Immediate $2k trial credit applied to your sandbox
- Temporary re-enable of API keys for the POC project
- Short addendum to confirm the extension window: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/trial-addendum-template-v2 (please review; Procure can sign back)

Action items for FluxGrid:
1) Confirm billing contact or HubSpot deal id so we can tag the credit to the right record.
2) Reply with availability for a 30-min post-run health call (we recommend Wed or Thu).

I've attached the logs you sent and the addendum draft.

Thanks — fingers crossed for a strong run.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
